image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a pile of cooked Dungeness crabs. The crabs are bright red and orange, indicating they have been boiled or steamed. They are stacked haphazardly, with various carapaces, legs, and claws visible. Some parts of the white ventral side (underside) are exposed where the crabs are overturned. The texture appears wet and glossy.
